in_marathi.name: Arumugam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arumugam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arumugam is a Tamil name derived from the Tamil god Ayyappan, also known as Murugan or Arumugam Murugan. This name signifies the god as the Lord of Wealth and the giver of boons. Arumugam is believed to be the protector of the devotees, fulfilling their wishes and granting prosperity and wealth.
